system.description:
When you start the main process and your [Hate] is 10 or more, your [HP] recovers by 40 points, and one of the BS you are currently receiving is removed. 「Work, work, and work on」—a two-handed sword with child-like, faded Alvean script carved across its blade like a pattern. The lost ancient magic continuously gives its wielder vitality solely for the purpose of battle. This curse-like effect becomes more active the more intense the combat, restoring the wielder's health while being bombarded with hostility and pushing away harmful influences.

Ancient Charm Fragment [Core Material] (680G) + Espadon (1400G) + [Magic Catalyst 20] (370G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (1370G)
